hard startup error, so --tools is validated against this exact vocabulary.

tools mm_check, mm_symbol, mm_refs, mm_type, mm_slice, mm_packet, mm_system,
mm_verify. Those are the names the daemon verbs in TOOL_TO_VERB are keyed by.
